tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.guards: free-text SQLi scan; ≤4 calls; hidden after a strong prefetch hit; weak matches flagged
tools.on_failure: no relevant article ⇒ agent must say so / hand off

tools.name: get_customer_profile
tools.purpose: Plan, tier, status, card summary of the signed-in customer
tools.guards: identity from JWT; no id parameter

tools.name: get_payment_status
tools.guards: invoice id regex + strict SQLi scan; same error for foreign and missing ids

tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
tools.guards: pure function of data + today's date

tools.name: create_refund_request
tools.purpose: Files a refund request (auto-approved ≤ $100, else pending approval)
tools.guards: customer refund intent + dispatcher flag; eligibility re-derived; idempotent; audited
tools.on_failure: blocked + security event; model must explain instead

tools.name: get_user_logs
tools.purpose: Error events grouped by code (≤168 h)

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.guards: only if the customer asks; idempotent for 10 min; audited

tools.name: assign_to_human
tools.guards: one row per query; PII masked before storage; audited
tools.on_failure: reply falls back to a safe holding message

tools_common: Every call: per-agent allow-list, strict schema, SQLi scan, identity injected from the session, ≤12 calls/query, 10 s timeout, traced span (PII-masked).

agents.name: Input guard
agents.can: Sanitise, mask secrets and card numbers, refuse injection / SQLi / empty input, flag foreign ids
agents.cannot: Call tools, see the profile, produce customer-facing answers beyond fixed refusals
agents.failure: Regexes are deterministic. The optional LLM gray-zone check fails open to the regex result

agents.name: Dispatcher
agents.can: Choose ≤3 intents (incl. escalation, off_topic), urgency, sentiment, refund_requested, per-intent sub-questions
agents.cannot: Call tools or answer. Deterministic triggers override it
agents.failure: LLM error ⇒ keyword fallback + escalation; confidence < 0.55 ⇒ add escalation

agents.name: Billing agent
agents.can: Read the customer's invoices and payments, run the policy engine, file a refund request when asked and eligible
agents.cannot: Choose whose data to read, refund unasked, open tickets unasked, claim an action that was not done, mention other agents
agents.tools: get_invoices, get_payment_status, check_refund_eligibility, create_refund_request, search_knowledge_base, create_ticket
agents.failure: Exception ⇒ becomes a needs_human output; ≤4 iterations

agents.name: Technical agent
agents.can: Read logs and service status, run read-only diagnostics, search the KB, open a ticket on request
agents.cannot: Same limits as billing; no billing tools

agents.name: General agent
agents.can: Answer policy / account / product questions from the KB
agents.cannot: Read account data beyond the profile; no write tools

agents.name: Escalation agent
agents.can: Read ticket history, write the handoff note, create the review row
agents.cannot: Resolve the issue, promise outcomes, admit fault, lower the deterministic priority floor
agents.failure: LLM error ⇒ template note; tool error ⇒ safe holding message. Escalation never fails

agents.name: Validator
agents.can: approve / request one revision / send to a human
agents.cannot: Edit the reply, call write tools, fall back to a weaker model

agents.name: Human (staff)
agents.can: Approve, edit or reject a held draft; approve or reject a pending refund
agents.cannot: Be bypassed for refunds over $100 or for held drafts
agents.tools: review-queue API / Slack buttons (agent_staff, admin roles)
agents.failure: Case stays pending (see gaps: no SLA timer yet)

nodes: dispatcher ‖ safety model ‖ KB warm-up (parallel, then joined)
fan-out: ≤2 specialists + escalation in parallel (LangGraph Send)
rules: Graph state is checkpointed (SQLite) so a paused human-review run survives restarts

Any unhandled error ⇒ safe fallback: holding reply + review row
Validated KB-only answers can be served from an exact-match cache (no LLM calls)

zones.rule: JWT, role, rate limit, body size, schema; the customer id is taken from the token only
Deterministic filters before any model sees text
May be manipulated; hold no credentials; their outputs are proposals, not actions

boundaries: Customer text → agents: only through the input guard, always framed as untrusted data
Agent → tool: only through the tool runtime
Tool → database: only parameterised, customer-scoped queries
Agent → customer: only through the validator
Staff → system: only through role-checked endpoints
Logs / traces / Slack: PII and card data masked before write

policies.rule: The model never chooses whose data is read; customer_id is injected from the session and a different one is blocked and logged
Each agent has an allow-list of tools; write tools are further gated
Refund eligibility is code; >$100 needs a human; writes are idempotent and audited
Refunds and tickets only when the customer asked for them
Input guard (regex noisy-OR, gray-zone LLM check), topic control, untrusted-text framing
Card numbers, SSN, IBAN and API keys are masked before any model sees them or anything is stored
Every amount, date, id and number-with-unit in a reply must exist in the evidence; unsupported 'does not support X' claims are blocked
'Refund approved' only if approved; promises of actions that were not performed are blocked
Other customers' ids, internal tool names, prompt text, raw metadata never reach a reply
Validator or judge unavailable ⇒ human review, never an unverified answer; the judge never uses a weaker fallback model
Every write and every blocked call is in audit_log / security_events; every decision is traced with PII masked
JWT with roles and expiry, login lockout, rate limits, body-size cap, generic 500s

One revision with the exact issues; then human review

gaps: There is no payment processor or order system behind the tools: a refund is a record in a synthetic database, not a payout.
Pending reviews have no SLA timer, so nobody is alerted if staff never respond.
No tool changes a payment method or plan; those are guidance-only.
Escalation holding replies are English only.
The rate limiter and answer cache are per process; SQLite is single-writer (Postgres/Redis for scale).
The judge and the specialists are the same model family, so shared blind spots are possible.
This scope was written after the system was built; it documents what exists and where it falls short.
